issues.title: Total score is read from submitted QS totals instead of the SAP item-sum rule
issues.summary: SAP page 47 defines how ADAS-Cog(11) totals handle missing items; the specification reads the submitted ACTOT QSSTRESN instead of expressing that computation.
issues.expected: SAP page 47: a total is missing if more than 30% of items are missing; otherwise the item sum is scaled to the full range, e.g. by 70 / (70 - 10).
issues.observed: _SELECTED_AVAL takes QS.QSSTRESN on ACTOT rows; the specification states no item sum or missing-item adjustment.
issues.action: Confirm that the SDTM QSSTRESN total already applies the SAP scoring and cite that SDTM method, or compute the total from the items.

citations.quote:
The following applies to all totals and subtotals of ADAS-Cog(11) and NPI-X, and does
not apply to CIBIC+.
Any computed total score will be treated as missing if more than 30% of the items are
missing or scored “not applicable”. For example, when computing ADAS-Cog(11), if 4
or more items are missing, then the total score will not be computed. When one or more
items are missing (but not more than 30%), the total score will be adjusted in order to
maintain the full range of the scale. For example, ADAS-Cog(11) is a 0-70 scale. If the
first item, Word Recall (ranges from 0 to 10), is missing, then the remaining 10 items of
the ADAS-Cog(11) will be summed and multiplied by (70 / (70-10) ), or 7/6.

_SELECTED_AVAL:
        case:
          - when: "ANL01FL = 'Y'"
            then: QS.QSSTRESN

issues.title: Baseline window range is <=1 in the SAP but reads < 1 in the extracted text
issues.summary: Define-XML points AWRANGE to the SAP window table; the extracted table reads Baseline < 1 where the original PDF shows <=1, so the range text cannot be checked literally.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADQSADAS.AWRANGE: window range specified in the SAP. SAP page 11: Baseline <=1, Week 8 2-84, Week 16 85-140, Week 24 >140.
issues.observed: The rule cannot be probed from the extracted text. Pilot 6's later R reimplementation adadas.r uses <=1, 2-84, 85-140 and >140 (L83-L89) on every record (L142-L147).
issues.action: Confirm that the Baseline range is <=1 as in the original SAP and state the range strings in Define-XML.

citations.quote: Window range, specified in the SAP.

3 Baseline < 1 1
8 Week 8 2-84 56
10 Week 16 85-140 112
ADAS-Cog
CIBIC+
12 Week 24 >140 168

aw_lookup <- tribble(
  ~AVISIT, ~AWRANGE, ~AWTARGET, ~AWLO, ~AWHI,
  "Baseline", "<=1", 1, NA_integer_, 1,
  "Week 8", "2-84", 56, 2, 84,
  "Week 16", "85-140", 112, 85, 140,
  "Week 24", ">140", 168, 141, NA_integer_
)

# re-derive AWRANGE/AWTARGET/AWTDIFF/AWLO/AWHI/AWU
  select(-c("AWRANGE", "AWTARGET", "AWLO", "AWHI")) %>%
  derive_vars_merged(
    dataset_add = aw_lookup,
    by_vars = exprs(AVISIT)
  ) %>%

issues.title: Missing Baseline window start is not stated in the documents
issues.summary: The SAP Baseline window has no lower bound; the specification stores AWLO as missing for Baseline, an encoding no retained document states.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADQSADAS.AWLO: start day of the window, specified in the SAP. SAP page 11: Baseline <=1 with no lower bound; Week 8 2-84, Week 16 85-140, Week 24 >140.
issues.observed: AWLO maps Baseline to missing and Weeks 8, 16 and 24 to 2, 85 and 141. Pilot 6's later R reimplementation adadas.r stores NA for Baseline (L83-L89) on every record (L142-L147).
issues.action: Confirm that an open window start is stored as missing and note it in Define-XML.

issues.title: Missing Week 24 window end is not stated in the documents
issues.summary: The SAP Week 24 window has no upper bound; the specification stores AWHI as missing for Week 24, an encoding no retained document states.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADQSADAS.AWHI: end day of the window, specified in the SAP. SAP page 11: Baseline <=1, Week 8 2-84, Week 16 85-140, Week 24 >140 with no upper bound.
issues.observed: AWHI maps Baseline, Week 8 and Week 16 to 1, 84 and 140 and Week 24 to missing. Pilot 6's later R reimplementation adadas.r stores NA for Week 24 (L83-L89) on every record (L142-L147).
issues.action: Confirm that an open window end is stored as missing and note it in Define-XML.

issues.title: Analysis date fills partial QS dates with day 1 without a documented rule
issues.summary: The specification imputes ADT from QS.QSDTC with day 1 for partial dates; the documents state only a date conversion, and their first-day imputation rule is for adverse events.
issues.expected: The retained ADT rule converts QS.QSDTC to a SAS date and states no partial-date imputation; the data guide's first-of-month rule applies to adverse events.
issues.observed: In obs, ADT is an impute of type date from QS.QSDTC with day: 1.
issues.action: Remove the imputation if QS dates are complete, or document a partial-date rule for ADQSADAS.

citations.quote:
ADT:
        impute:
          type: date
          source: QS.QSDTC
          day: 1
